title: fix round 1: S1c worker_registry: durable runtime registry of running workers with structured events, r
spec: Fix round 1 for T-1048 (gate red: acceptance tests missing). The tests below were named in the acceptance but their files were outside the original write scope; this round adds tests/test_executor.py, tests/test_daemon.py to the scope. Write exactly these tests as unittest.TestCase methods, matching the behaviour the merged implementation in this worktree already has (adjust the implementation only if a test exposes a real defect): tests/test_executor.py::test_codex_registry_entry_is_live_before_exit (patched Popen: entry exists with pid and status running while the process runs; usage and exit events after); tests/test_executor.py::test_codex_timeout_kills_process (patched Popen whose communicate raises TimeoutExpired: kill called, failed result returned, registry finish failed); tests/test_daemon.py::test_tick_reconciles_registry_once_per_tick (patched worker_registry.reconcile called once with the daemon's alive function). Keep every other acceptance line green; run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until it exits 0. Do not ask questions; report files changed and failures-only output.
acceptance: tests/test_worker_registry.py::test_upsert_event_finish_roundtrip (document and event file shapes, atomic write, elapsed computed)
tests/test_worker_registry.py::test_reconcile_marks_dead_pids (alive_fn false marks failed process_dead and appends reconciled event; alive entries untouched)
tests/test_worker_registry.py::test_registry_never_stores_prompt_text (upsert with a packet or prompt kwarg raises ValueError)
tests/test_spawn.py::test_spawn_records_worker_registry_entry (patched Popen and json output produce spawned, usage and exit events)
tests/test_cli.py::test_workers_cli_lists_active (workers --json lists an active entry; --task shows events)
tests/test_executor.py::test_codex_registry_entry_is_live_before_exit (patched Popen: entry exists with pid and status running while the process runs; usage and exit events after)
tests/test_daemon.py::test_tick_reconciles_registry_once_per_tick (patched worker_registry.reconcile called once with the daemon's alive function)
tests/test_executor.py::test_codex_timeout_kills_process (patched Popen whose communicate raises TimeoutExpired: kill called, failed result returned, registry finish failed)
fix round: the previously missing tests exist as unittest methods in tests/test_executor.py, tests/test_daemon.py
